Election 2024 live updates Democrats continue to rally around Harris after Biden’s exit

clock iconUpdated
July 22, 2024 at 1:42 p.m. EDT
Listen
1 min
Share
Save

Democrats are continuing to rally around Vice President Harris to take over as the party’s presidential nominee following President Biden’s abrupt exit from his reelection campaign Sunday. Harris has received a rapid flow of endorsements from top Democrats, including several who had been mentioned as possible replacements for Biden. Harris called Biden’s record “unmatched in modern history” at the outset of an event Monday honoring championship college athletic teams — Harris’s first public appearance since Biden left the ticket. Later Monday, Harris is traveling to campaign headquarters in Delaware.
